note: Gameplay approximations of the laws in force in Syria on 1 January 2000; choices are judgements, not checked line by line against a fetched source. Elections: the People's Council was elected with the front's lists and independents under Ba'ath leadership (single_party_elections). Economy: a largely state-run economy with limited liberalisation (state_capitalism). Trade: managed through state controls (managed_trade). Conscription: compulsory military service (universal_conscription). Religion: a secular-leaning state with religious personal-status law (religious_law_partial).
